name: 86 Chaos 16.0.34 Restaurant AI Assistants and Free Data Layer
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.34 Restaurant AI Assistants and Free Data Layer
notes: Adds review-first restaurant AI assistants for 86Voice, Manager Brief explanations, invoice line cleanup, price jump detection, prep prediction, schedule risk, menu intelligence, maintenance patterns, and semantic Help Center search.
Preserves existing UI structure, Firebase wiring, rules, indexes, credentials, permissions, routes, tabs, scanner review flows, and operational workflows.
releaseNotes: 86Voice can answer higher-level readiness, labor/schedule, prep, maintenance, price-jump, weather, and food/allergen lookup questions using real loaded app data and protected public-data routes.
Manager Brief Need Attention cards now include an Explain action with what triggered the card, why it matters, and the safest next action.
Invoice review now runs a smart line-item cleaner after OCR/AI extraction to normalize product names, SKUs, quantities, pack sizes, and prices before manager approval.
Inventory/AI Order surfaces price-jump warnings, prep prediction, event supply checks, and review-first order drafts with reasons and confidence signals.
Help Center search now includes semantic matching across real customer-safe articles and the training manual.
